# The repos the canary builds besides those of the packages Nim's CI tests, which
# it reads from Nim devel's testament/important_packages.nim. One per line:
# Status' Nim libraries (the status-im repos on Status' shared CI workflow) and
# two of the projects built on them, then packages from the wider Nim community.
# Each one is built the same way, as the build job in .github/workflows/canary.yml
# shows; `install-only` skips `nimble test`, the only reason to list one of Nim
# CI's packages here. The order doesn't matter: the slowest repos start first.
#
# To look for status-im repos on the shared workflow that aren't built yet, here
# or as Nim CI's packages:
#   gh search code "nimbus-common-workflow/.github/workflows/common.yml" --owner status-im

status-im/nim-async-channels
status-im/nim-bearssl
status-im/nim-blscurve install-only    # its tests need the eth2 test vectors its CI downloads
status-im/nim-dnsdisc install-only     # it requires any eth, and the latest moved a module it imports
status-im/nim-ethash
status-im/nim-graphql install-only     # its test task passes nim `--styleCheck: error` (a typo)
status-im/nim-kzg4844
status-im/nim-libbacktrace
status-im/nim-minilru
status-im/nim-protobuf-serialization
status-im/nim-raft
status-im/nim-secp256k1
status-im/nim-ttmath
status-im/nim-zlib

vacp2p/nim-libp2p install-only         # its tests are timing-sensitive
status-im/nimbus-eth1 install-only     # its dependency graph is the point; its tests build a full node

# The community: packages whose `nimble test` passes on a plain runner, and,
# install-only, projects whose dependencies exercise nimble: lock files, `#sha`,
# URL and forked requirements, features, and dependencies with binaries, hooks or
# submodules.
nim-lang/langserver
yglukhov/yasync
squattingmonk/nasher
HugoGranstrom/nimiSlides install-only  # no tests
fox0430/moe install-only               # its tests need X11
HapticX/happyx install-only            # its tests run servers
nim-lang/nimforum install-only         # its tests need a browser
nim-lang/choosenim install-only        # its tests download Nim
arnetheduck/nph install-only           # no tests
dom96/jester install-only              # its tests need libpcre
treeform/boxy install-only             # its tests need OpenGL
crashappsec/chalk install-only         # its tests need Docker
inv2004/ttop install-only              # no tests
krisppurg/dimscord install-only        # its tests aren't run upstream either
niv/neverwinter.nim install-only       # its tests need the game's base scripts

# Nim CI's packages whose tests fail with both nimbles for reasons of their own:
# they need what a plain runner lacks, install their test dependencies some
# other way, or don't build with Nim 2.4 or GCC 14.
andreaferretti/neo install-only        # it uses shallowCopy, which ORC lacks
Araq/ormin install-only                # its tests run atlas-run
bluenote10/NimSvg install-only         # its tests need libpcre
brentp/hts-nim install-only            # its tests need libhts
disruptek/sigv4 install-only           # its tests import balls, which it doesn't require
fowlmouth/nake install-only            # its tests need libpcre
genotrance/nimgen install-only         # its tests need X11 headers
jblindsay/kdtree install-only          # its tests' float checks fail
moigagoo/norm install-only             # its tests need PostgreSQL
mratsim/Arraymancer install-only       # its tests need BLAS
mratsim/constantine install-only       # its tests don't compile with Nim 2.4
nim-lang/nimterop install-only         # its tests need Nim's source tree
pietroppeter/nimib install-only        # its tests need libpcre
planety/prologue install-only          # `nimble test` finds no tests
SciNim/Measuremancer install-only      # its testDeps task installs what its tests import
SciNim/nim-plotly install-only         # its tests need libpcre
SciNim/numericalnim install-only       # its testDeps task installs what its tests import
soasme/nim-markdown install-only       # its tests need libpcre
status-im/nim-confutils install-only   # its tests import toml_serialization, which it doesn't require
status-im/nim-toml-serialization install-only  # its tests import stint, which it doesn't require
Vindaar/ggplotnim install-only         # its tests need cairo
yglukhov/asyncthreadpool install-only  # its tests don't compile with GCC 14
yglukhov/nimpy install-only            # its tests need python2
zedeus/nitter install-only             # its tests need Redis and libpcre
zevv/npeg install-only                 # its C++ tests crash
